title: Beyond-Birthday-Bound AE under Arbitrary Nonce Repetition
summary: SCT has beyond-birthday-bound security only for nonce-respecting use; constructing authenticated encryption with such security under arbitrary nonce repetition remains open.

formal_statement.body: Construct an authenticated-encryption (AE) scheme that remains beyond-birthday-bound (BBB) secure even when nonces are repeated arbitrarily. The main technical difficulty is constructing a deterministic, stateless, BBB-secure message authentication code (MAC), which is known to be notably hard.

scope.domain: Authenticated-encryption and message-authentication design under nonce misuse.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct an authenticated-encryption scheme retaining beyond-birthday-bound security under arbitrary nonce repetition, overcoming the deterministic, stateless MAC obstacle.

citations.label: Counter-in-Tweak: Authenticated Encryption Modes for Tweakable Block Ciphers

progress.summary: The source explicitly presents this as a challenging open problem and identifies constructing a deterministic, stateless, beyond-birthday-bound-secure MAC as the main difficulty.
